title: Euclidean coefficient norm of covectors: pull-back, interior-product and orthonormal-evaluation bounds (parent (L0)–(L3))
statement: For all N, N', k ∈ ℕ, writing |α| for covectorEuclideanNorm α (the Euclidean norm of the values of a covector α on the strictly increasing tuples of standard basis vectors) and ‖·‖ for the Euclidean norm of vectors and the operator norm of linear maps: (L1) for every continuous linear map A : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} and every k-covector β on ℝ^{N'}, the pull-back A^#β(w_1, …, w_k) := β(Aw_1, …, Aw_k) (Lean β.compContinuousLinearMap A) satisfies |A^#β| ≤ ‖A‖^k·|β|; (L2) for every v ∈ ℝ^N and every (k+1)-covector β on ℝ^N, the interior product ι_vβ(w_1, …, w_k) := β(v, w_1, …, w_k) (Lean β.curryLeft v) satisfies |ι_vβ| ≤ |v|·|β|; (L3) for every k-covector α on ℝ^N and every orthonormal family τ_1, …, τ_k in ℝ^N, |α(τ_1, …, τ_k)| ≤ |α|.
lean_statement: (∀ (N N' k : ℕ) (A : Euclid N →L[ℝ] Euclid N') (β : Covector (Euclid N') k), covectorEuclideanNorm (β.compContinuousLinearMap A) ≤ ‖A‖ ^ k * covectorEuclideanNorm β) ∧ (∀ (N k : ℕ) (v : Euclid N) (β : Covector (Euclid N) (k + 1)), covectorEuclideanNorm (β.curryLeft v) ≤ ‖v‖ * covectorEuclideanNorm β) ∧ ∀ (N k : ℕ) (α : Covector (Euclid N) k) (τ : Fin k → Euclid N), Orthonormal ℝ τ → |α τ| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α
